snippet.title: TFMF - Official Playtest 2 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔗 Wishlist THE FACTORY MUST FALL on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3970860/The_Factory_Must_Fall/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/GyUyKKF2S6

Build a factory, then let it battle other players! Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your friends and foes in this PvP factory-builder.
